note: D12 perf gate — maxMedian is the ceiling the gate compares each metric's p10 against (the key name predates the estimator change; the numbers are what matters). POLICY, alpha72: floor = 2x the measured p10, never raised without an argument in the commit, lowered whenever a metric gets faster. 2x, not the old >=2x-of-median, because the estimator changed: a median on a shared machine spread 30% across three runs of the same build, so the headroom had to absorb the measurement rather than the hardware. p10 is stable to ~7%, which leaves 2x to cover a slower CI box and nothing else. Before this, every floor sat 2.4-7.3x above its number and the gate had been gating nothing — which is how proxy-array-10k drifted 30 -> 55 ms unremarked. `check:bench` now reports that slack instead of hiding it.
